description:
Overview of the EUDI Wallet in all 27 EU member states: wallet name, status and short note.

        Status meaning: certified (listed as certified EUDI Wallet), live (precursor app with digital credentials
        in operation), pilot (tests with real users or public test version), upgrade (existing government app
        officially set to become the EUDI Wallet), announced (project known, no public app), unclear.
        Optionally filter by status. Use get_country for sources and history of one country.
name: list_countries
title: List EUDI Wallets by country
